steps.note: the API built this case's state
Enable the required tenant behavior for deleting line items from PR-linked events.
Open the RFQ stage's Overview tab where the line-items table is shown.
Confirm the target line item is present before attempting deletion.
Confirm the second active line item is also visible before deletion.

args.goal: On the RFQ Overview line-items table, open the three-dot row menu for QA_Platform Item A, choose Delete, confirm the deletion, and stop on the Overview screen after the item has disappeared.

steps.note: Perform the deletion flow that no dedicated catalog step exposes, including the confirmation dialog and removal from the table.
Verify the application reports the expected successful deletion.
Verify the deleted line item no longer appears in the Overview table.
Verify the other line item remains visible after deletion.
Navigate to the Purchase Requisitions area to inspect whether the deleted item is available for reuse.
Check the Open PR pool shows the deleted item and its original quantity, subject to the table exposing those labels.
